Potential execution of untrusted code on a privileged workflow ([pull_request_target](1))

[Show more details](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/security/code-scanning/212)
comments.label_reasoning: The comment flags a security vulnerability where untrusted code is checked out in a privileged workflow context (pull_request_target), which could lead to execution of malicious code with elevated permissions. This is a security/logic flaw in the CI workflow configuration.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Flags a security vulnerability (execution of untrusted code in a privileged workflow context) that implies the workflow code needs to be changed to remediate the issue.

## Cache Poisoning via execution of untrusted code

Potential cache poisoning in the context of the default branch due to privilege checkout of untrusted code. ([pull_request_target](1)).

[Show more details](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/security/code-scanning/214)
comments.label_reasoning: The comment flags a cache poisoning vulnerability caused by privileged checkout of untrusted code in the default branch context, which deviates from the intended secure behavior of the CI workflow.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Flags a security vulnerability (cache poisoning via privileged checkout of untrusted code) that implies the workflow code needs to be changed to remediate the issue.
